manual_checks.item: Verify semantic structure end-to-end: h1 in header, tablist/tab/tabpanel roles from Radix, main landmark, footer as structural element (no contentinfo role after F-02 fix).
Verify color is not the only means of conveying information (e.g. active tab state uses visual indicator beyond color alone).
Verify all functionality is operable via keyboard only (tab into tablist, navigate triggers, open panels, interact with panel content).
Verify focus order is logical and predictable: header → tablist → active panel content → footer.
Verify content reflows without loss at 320px width (Tailwind responsive layout, TabsList w-full, no horizontal scroll).

TSK-143 specific — Radix keyboard delegation (now unblocked after F-01 fix): Tab key reaches the tablist; within the tablist ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigate between triggers; Home moves to first trigger; End moves to last trigger. Verify ARIA wiring is correct for all 4 tab/panel pairs.

TSK-143 specific — After F-01 fix (id props removed): verify aria-controls on each TabsTrigger correctly points to its TabsContent panel (Radix-generated IDs), and aria-labelledby on each panel correctly points back to its trigger. All 4 tab/panel pairs must be wired. Verify with screen reader or manual DOM inspection.

TSK-143 specific — Panel Play forceMount + data-[state=inactive]:hidden: verify that when Play is not the active tab, the panel is not perceivable by assistive technologies. Radix sets the HTML hidden attribute on inactive TabsContent (removing from a11y tree); the Tailwind data-[state=inactive]:hidden rule provides a defensive CSS layer.

TSK-143 specific — Color contrast of TabsTrigger active/inactive states in light and dark themes: active state uses data-[state=active]:bg-background + data-[state=active]:text-foreground; inactive uses text-muted-foreground on bg-muted. Verify contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for normal text in both themes.

positive_findings: F-01 CLOSED (iter-2): aria-valid-attr-value Critical resolved — explicit id props removed from all TabsTrigger and TabsContent elements; Radix now manages ARIA IDs and aria-controls/aria-labelledby wiring internally without conflicts.

F-02 CLOSED (iter-2): landmark-contentinfo-is-top-level Minor resolved — role='contentinfo' and aria-label removed from the footer in App.tsx; footer is now a structural element, no landmark nesting violation.
Radix Tabs manages role='tablist', role='tab', role='tabpanel' and aria-selected natively — no manual ARIA role maintenance required.
TabsList has aria-label='Sezioni app' — provides accessible name for the tablist landmark.
TabsTrigger has focus-visible ring styles (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2) — WCAG 2.4.7 / 2.4.11 focus visibility satisfied.
<h1> in header wraps logo img with alt='Soli-boy' — WCAG 1.1.1 and page-has-heading-one landmark both satisfied.
ConfirmGameChangeDialog implements role='dialog' + aria-modal='true' + aria-labelledby + aria-describedby + Esc handler + Tab/Shift+Tab focus trap — robust WAI-ARIA modal implementation.
Color contrast overrides in app-extra.css (TSK-084) pre-empt known contrast failures for dark, 90s-party, cyberpunk themes.
Keyboard navigation (Arrow/Home/End) delegated to Radix — no manual handler drift risk.
forceMount on panel Play with Radix-managed hidden attribute: Player stays mounted without exposing a11y items in inactive state.
